note: One spec for success and failure. The session record is required on every path; each finished unit's records (report, per-item rows, recovery config/log/product identity, eval logs) are pulled by the launcher's poll hook as the unit finishes and are optional here (an early failure legitimately produced none). Recovered students are NOT collected: they live on the session's network volume and are named by sha256 in the records (P8.4).
